items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: President Paul asked me, well, Chani, how you do such and such a thing?

ctx.x: Keep that going all the time.

And I was always taught by Mac Murray. He sat on. Well, he gave me the instruction about your time. See, like I once told you, I liked him for orchestra drummer, and I also liked it, Loie Contra for street drummer. So one day at the Lincoln Park, Mac Murray and I were talking, and he took nice liking and telling me because he saw that I was happening, he said, someday you'll make a great drummer. He said, well, I want to tell you one thing. He said, well, all you do, always watch your bass drum. He said, because…
Yeah. Did you ever take many drum solos in the old days, a whole chorus by yourself?
